payload.title: Ryan: request SES production access for the new account, then ramp
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M2, operators finished

**Goal.** Public mail cannot start before this. The request carries a legal acknowledgement, so it is Ryan's. AWS's first reply is within 96 hours by its documentation; submit it during M1 so it does not hold M3.

**Build.**
1. Run `aws sesv2 put-account-details --production-access-enabled --mail-type MARKETING --website-url https://p.apyr.us --additional-contact-email-addresses <Ryan's choice> --contact-language EN` in `caducus-production`, or use the console. MARKETING because AWS defines one-to-many mail that way and new-story mail will be the majority. If asked about list mail, say truthfully: double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe, bounce and complaint suppression, no open or click tracking.
2. Sandbox status is per Region: us-east-1 only for now.

Ramp (agents do this after approval): operators only, then Machines on Machines subscribers, then a batch of sites. Pace with `MaxSendRate`, read live from `sesv2 get_account` as `src/papyrus_content/newsletter/worker.py` does; no fixed daily caps of our own. Watch Reputation.BounceRate and Reputation.ComplaintRate between steps.

**Acceptance.**
`aws sesv2 get-account` shows ProductionAccessEnabled true.

**Depends on:** kanbus-d0987c
